rosa-starter.title: Your $150 deposit from Sept. 1 was sent back
rosa-starter.body: Your bank sent it back on Sept. 3, so the money never reached First Leaf. Your funds were not touched.
rosa-starter.nextStep: Check your bank account first. Then you can try the deposit again.

rosa-starter.title: Your goal is $150 behind your plan
rosa-starter.body: You planned to put in $1,400 by now. So far $1,250 went through. This only counts deposits, not the market.
rosa-starter.nextStep: You can add a one-time deposit to catch up, or keep going as planned. Either is fine.

rosa-starter.title: $154.76 is waiting in cash
rosa-starter.body: Auto-invest has been paused since July 14, so deposits since then stay as cash. Cash does not go up or down with the market.
rosa-starter.nextStep: It is your choice. You can turn auto-invest back on, or leave it paused.

rosa-starter.title: FL-GREEN is raising its yearly fee on Oct. 1
rosa-starter.body: The fee goes from 0.45% to 0.75%. On the $48.63 you have in it, that is about $0.15 more a year.
rosa-starter.nextStep: Nothing changes in your account unless you choose to. The fund page shows its fee over time.

rosa-starter.title: FL-BOND paid you $0.50
rosa-starter.body: Some funds make small payments to the people who own them. It went into your cash.
rosa-starter.nextStep: Nothing to do. This is just so you know.

rosa-all-clear.title: FL-BOND paid you $0.64
rosa-all-clear.body: Some funds make small payments to the people who own them. It went into your cash.
rosa-all-clear.nextStep: Nothing to do. This is just so you know.
